segments.comment: Admission-only probe retained with its matching recording: the leading space is consumed as an unknown command, then ; reaches the production blind quick-glance prompt, but the final . remains at its --More-- boundary. It does not establish location selection or description parity. The valid longer input is retained separately as blind-glance-description-blocked-independent.session.json; its selected-location continuation now has a matching recording after correcting the !quick condition before checkfile in pager.c do_look.
